description: Commands checked before dispatch (cli._ordinary_main) when an argument, an option value or the working directory lies in a controller-owned run or its store. Controller entries pass; refused rows are refused; read-only rows pass; every other command is refused by default. Module entry points use the pseudo-commands workflow_state, gate_wiring, active_run, graph_substrate and lifecycle.

controller_entries.reason: the operator's channel, outside any worker

refused.reason: approval of a controller-owned run comes only from the authority service (the physicist's controller terminal or the operator's configuration)
the CHECK-IN 2 GO of a controller-owned run is an authority-service record
a controller-owned run advances only through its graph
approval and lifecycle records of a controller-owned run are written by the controller only
responses to a controller-owned run's check-ins come only through the authority service

a controller-owned run's stop is released by the operator (`ravel operator resume`) or the physicist at the controller's terminal
a controller-owned run does not use the host session registry; releasing or rebinding it changes nothing the controller reads
